headline: Indian defense firm partners with Nigeria for military maintenance facilities
summary: Indian defense and aerospace firm Airbornics Defence & Space partnered with Nigeria's Nigus Hercules Limited to help develop local facilities for repairing and maintaining military equipment.
why: Defense technology partnerships support local industrial capability development and maintenance logistics for state militaries.

impacts.name: Aerospace & Defense
impacts.why: Bilateral defense service agreements expand technological cooperation and local maintenance capabilities.
